definitions.gloss: to install, to attach, to fit
definitions.explanation: To install equipment or attach something to a fixed position. Often used for mounting devices, fixtures, or appliances.
To successfully obtain an appointment, meeting, or promise from someone.

examples.japanese: エアコンを{取|と}り{付|つ}ける{工事|こうじ}をした。
examples.english: We had the air conditioner installed.

examples.japanese: {棚|たな}を{壁|かべ}に{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I attached the shelf to the wall.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}に{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラを{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I installed a security camera at the entrance.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}との{面会|めんかい}の{約束|やくそく}を{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I secured an appointment for a meeting with the president.

examples.japanese: {出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}から{契約|けいやく}を{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I secured a contract from the publisher.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}から{協力|きょうりょく}の{約束|やくそく}を{取|と}り{付|つ}けることができた。
examples.english: I was able to secure a promise of cooperation from the other party.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Intransitive pair: {取|と}り{付|つ}く.

COMPOUND VERB: Formed from {取|と}る (to take) + {付|つ}ける (to attach).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・エアコンを{取|と}り{付|つ}ける (install an air conditioner)
・{棚|たな}を{取|と}り{付|つ}ける (install a shelf)
・センサーを{取|と}り{付|つ}ける (install a sensor)
・{約束|やくそく}を{取|と}り{付|つ}ける (secure a promise)
・アポを{取|と}り{付|つ}ける (secure an appointment)

RELATED: {取|と}り{外|はず}す (to remove/detach) is the opposite action.
